en: The front of the postcard features a sepia-toned image of an ornate building with classical architecture and multiple windows, surrounded by terraces, staircases with stone railings, formal gardens, hedges, and a fountain. The background has tall trees. The bottom of the image reads 'BAD PYRMONT.' and 'PARTIE AM KURHAUS'. The back of the postcard shows handwritten text in German, a stamp area, circular postal markings, a prominent blue museum stamp labeled 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT', and references to dates and catalog numbers.
